'''Kriost Station''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] located in deep space and utilized as a trading outpost. [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] ran an operation out of the station before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], but was disrupted by the interference of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tobar Ka-Teen/Legends|Tobar Ka-Teen]].
